analysis_runs.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE analysis_runs(
 analysis_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id),
 metric_definition_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES metric_definitions(metric_definition_id),
 code_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,results_digest TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(campaign_id,metric_definition_id,code_sha256)
)

artifact_refs.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_refs(
 analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_runs(analysis_id),kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 path TEXT NOT NULL,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(analysis_id,kind)
)

campaigns.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE campaigns(campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_path TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL)

metric_definitions.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE metric_definitions(
 metric_definition_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version TEXT NOT NULL, normative_edition TEXT NOT NULL,
 unit TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(unit IN ('mg','mm/s')), band_low_hz REAL NOT NULL,band_high_hz REAL NOT NULL,
 axes_status TEXT NOT NULL,definition_json TEXT NOT NULL
)

pk_analysis_runs.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE pk_analysis_runs(analysis_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,campaign_sha TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id),
 method_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pk_methods(method_id),runner_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,results_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(campaign_sha,method_id,runner_sha256))

pk_artifacts.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE pk_artifacts(analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pk_analysis_runs(analysis_id),kind TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,
 sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(analysis_id,kind))

pk_components.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE pk_components(analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pk_analysis_runs(analysis_id),start_mcu_s REAL NOT NULL,
 end_mcu_s REAL NOT NULL,window_mcu_s INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(window_mcu_s IN (10,60)),axis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(axis IN ('X','Y','Z')),
 sample_n INTEGER NOT NULL,valid_input_n INTEGER NOT NULL,frame_status TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,frequency_Hz REAL,
 component_pk REAL,component_rms REAL,reported_pk REAL,contrast_dB REAL,shape_error REAL,comparison_eligible INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(comparison_eligible IN (0,1)),
 comparison_zone TEXT NOT NULL,row_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(analysis_id,start_mcu_s,window_mcu_s,axis))

pk_controls.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE pk_controls(control_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,definition_json TEXT NOT NULL)

pk_methods.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE pk_methods(method_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,band TEXT NOT NULL,unit TEXT NOT NULL,clock TEXT NOT NULL,
 edition TEXT NOT NULL,derived_version TEXT NOT NULL,reference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pk_reference(reference_id),definition_json TEXT NOT NULL)

pk_migration_audit.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE pk_migration_audit(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),source_path TEXT NOT NULL,source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL)

pk_reference.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE pk_reference(reference_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,definition_json TEXT NOT NULL)

prequal_audit.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE prequal_audit(kind TEXT PRIMARY KEY,definition_json TEXT NOT NULL)

prequal_methods.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE prequal_methods(method_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,definition_json TEXT NOT NULL)

prequal_metrics.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE prequal_metrics(analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES prequal_runs,method_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES prequal_methods,width_s INTEGER NOT NULL,start_mcu_s INTEGER NOT NULL,result_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(analysis_id,method_id,width_s,start_mcu_s))

prequal_runs.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE prequal_runs(analysis_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,campaign_sha TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id),code_sha TEXT NOT NULL,result_sha TEXT NOT NULL,manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL)

window_metrics.schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE window_metrics(
 analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_runs(analysis_id),window_mcu_s INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(window_mcu_s IN (60,120)),
 start_mcu_s REAL NOT NULL,end_mcu_s REAL NOT NULL, observed_n INTEGER NOT NULL,
 valid_n INTEGER NOT NULL,coverage_observed REAL NOT NULL,quality TEXT NOT NULL,
 rms_x REAL,rms_y REAL,rms_z REAL,direction_max REAL,vector_technical REAL,peak_vector REAL,
 PRIMARY KEY(analysis_id,window_mcu_s,start_mcu_s)
)
